details: V0 Pre-flight Safety Check PASSED. Comments mention production but no actual production values present. (2) Allowed hosts only: All DATABASE_URL variables point to localhost:55432 (test-postgres container). No external hosts found. (3) Allowed commands only: verification.py uses run_command() which restricts execution to ALLOWED_COMMANDS=['pnpm', 'turbo', 'pytest', 'node', 'tsx', 'drizzle-kit', 'git', 'npm', 'npx', 'docker-compose'] as defined in runner.py. The verification pipeline (V0-V10) requires only 'pnpm', 'git', and 'docker-compose' which are all present in the allowed list. Test environment configuration: .env.test.local created with isolated test database (postgresql://test_user:test_password@localhost:55432/tutorial_test) using docker-compose.test-db.yml. Production .env.local remains untouched and will not be used during Stage 6 verification.
